en.headline: 72-year-old garage owner dies after car falls on him in Tseung Kwan O
en.dek: Police said the man was trapped under a private car he was repairing in Upper Village and later died in hospital.
body: Police received a report from a passer-by at about 2:50pm on Wednesday that a man had been trapped beneath a private car off Wing Lai Road in Tseung Kwan O Upper Village.

The 72-year-old garage owner was reportedly working under the vehicle near the rear when the car fell and trapped him. Neighbours and passers-by helped pull him free before emergency services arrived and took him to hospital.
He was later confirmed dead. Police are investigating the cause of the accident.

zh.headline: 將軍澳上村七旬車房東主修車遭壓 送院不治
zh.dek: 警方表示，事主在上村維修私家車期間遭車壓着，送院後不治。
body: 警方下午約2時50分接獲途人報案，指將軍澳上村穎禮路附近一名男子被私家車壓着。
該名72歲車房東主據報當時在車底近車尾位置維修，車輛突然墮下將他壓住。途人及鄰居合力將他拉出，救援人員到場後將他送院。
事主其後證實不治。警方正調查意外原因。
